description: NaMn(PO₃)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.47 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.24 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.63 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.62 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-71°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.62 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms.
